## 1.0 Asset Categories

This directory organizes assets into three primary categories to support the EA Practice's documentation and publishing needs.
page_texts.4:
[assets/README.md#11-logo-and-image-assets-images]

### 1.1 Logo and Image Assets (`images/`)

Corporate logo files and visual assets in various sizes for different use cases:

- **`gainwell_logo_dark_large.png`** - Dark theme logo for light backgrounds
- **`gainwell_logo_white.png`** - White logo for dark backgrounds
- **`gainwell_logo_dark_large.png`** - High-resolution logo for print materials and large displays
- **`gainwell_logo_dark_medium.png`** - Standard resolution for web headers and document templates
- **`gainwell_logo_dark_small.png`** - Compact version for favicons and small UI elements
- **`icon-*.png`** - Various icons for navigation and content organization
- **`GainwellStyleGuide_2024-1-2-.pdf`** - Official corporate style guide and brand standards
page_texts.5:
[assets/README.md#12-styling-resources-stylesheets]

### 1.2 Styling Resources (`stylesheets/`)

CSS files providing consistent visual identity across platforms:

- **`base.css`** - Core styling foundation with typography and layout basics
- **`custom.css`** - Corporate branding with Gainwell color scheme and fonts
- **`theme-light.css`** - Light theme optimized for screen viewing
- **`theme-dark.css`** - Dark theme for accessibility and preference options
- **`theme-print.css`** - Print-optimized styling for PDF generation and physical printing

[assets/README.md#13-javascript-resources-javascripts]

### 1.3 JavaScript Resources (`javascripts/`)

JavaScript files for enhanced functionality:

page_texts.8:
[assets/README.md#21-logo-usage]

### 2.1 Logo Usage

**Web Applications:**

- Use `images/gainwell_logo_dark_medium.png` for standard web headers
- Use `images/gainwell_logo_dark_small.png` for navigation bars and compact layouts
- Maintain proper aspect ratio and clear space around logos

**Print Materials:**

- Use `images/gainwell_logo_dark_large.png` for high-quality print output
- Ensure minimum size requirements per brand guidelines
- Follow color and placement standards from style guide

**MkDocs Integration:**

- Logos are automatically included during the build process
- Referenced in Material theme templates for consistent branding
- Maintain corporate identity across all published documentation
page_texts.9:
[assets/README.md#22-css-implementation]

### 2.2 CSS Implementation

**Template Integration:**

- `stylesheets/base.css` provides foundational styling for all documents
- `stylesheets/custom.css` adds Gainwell-specific branding and color scheme
- Theme files offer platform-specific optimizations

**Workflow Integration:**

- CSS files are automatically processed during document publishing
- MkDocs build process includes styles for web compatibility
- Print styles ensure professional PDF output

**Development Standards:**

- Follow CSS best practices and commenting standards
- Test across multiple browsers and platforms
- Ensure accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.2 AA)
page_texts.10:
[assets/README.md#23-brand-compliance]

### 2.3 Brand Compliance

**Color Palette:**

- Primary: rgb(0, 150, 129) (teal)
- Secondary: Colors defined in corporate style guide
- Maintain contrast ratios for accessibility

**Typography:**

- System fonts: Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif
- Hierarchical sizing consistent with brand standards
- Line height and spacing per corporate guidelines

**Visual Identity:**

- Logo placement follows brand standards
- Consistent spacing and alignment
- Professional appearance across all platforms

---
page_texts.12:
[assets/README.md#31-file-formats]

### 3.1 File Formats

**Logo Files:**

- Format: PNG with transparency support
- Resolution: Multiple sizes for different use cases
- Color Space: sRGB for web compatibility

**CSS Files:**

- Standard CSS3 with cross-browser compatibility
- Modular architecture for maintainability
- Commented code for documentation

**Documentation:**

- PDF format for official style guide
- Version-controlled for change tracking
page_texts.13:
[assets/README.md#32-integration-points]

### 3.2 Integration Points

**MkDocs Build Process:**

- Automated inclusion during site generation
- CSS preprocessing and optimization
- Asset validation and integrity checking

**Document Processing:**

- HTML template integration for branding
- PDF generation with corporate styling
- Responsive design for multiple device types

**Web Platform Compatibility:**

- Embedded CSS to ensure consistent styling
- Logo assets integrated into the MkDocs theme
- Consistent branding across documentation platforms
